To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
on the job and induction training have a significant relationship with employee productivity while formal training has a positive and significant impact on quality of service delivery.

the quality of service delivered by non academic staff in Nigerian public tertiary institution is influenced by training and development and this is a major determinant of the level of efficiency among non academic staff.
on the job and induction training are the only elements of employee training that enhance employee efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between employee training and development and employee performance in the Nigerian universities.
the impact of training and development on the performance of non academic staffs of Nigerian public universities.
the impact of training and development of employees on their efficiency in the workplace, and the effect this has on the quality of service provided to customers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the study reveals that training and development is a key to improving the quality of service and performance among the non academic staffs and this would enhance the overall efficiency of the Nigerian public universities.
training and development is a key factor in the success and growth of any organization, and this is true of public tertiary institutions in Nigeria.
training and development is the most effective way to reduce inefficiency among non-academic staffs in Nigerian universities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
training is a vital tool that can help to improve employee performance and productivity.
the training and development of non academic staff is very essential to the success of any institution.
training and development of employees in public tertiary institutions should not be seen as a cost but rather an investment that will yield a high return on investment (ROI).
The main takeaway from our work is that
employee training and development is an effective tool to reduce the rate of inefficiency and improve employee performance in Nigerian tertiary institutions.
training and development is a key to employee performance, and that training and development should not be seen as a cost to be minimized but as a strategic investment that pays dividends.
the Nigerian universities need to improve the quality of their training and development programs for non academic staffs to improve their efficiency in the discharge of their duties.
